subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful after-compaction plugin hooks receive a supported, current-session-scoped deferred reset capability?
rationale: This PR creates a new exported plugin API with session-lifecycle consequences; code review can assess mechanics, but only the hook/API owners can choose the permanent contract and whether an imperative context method is preferable to a typed hook result.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow API
options.body: Approve the current-session deferred method for successful, unlocked after-compaction hooks, then require documentation, SDK contract coverage, and complete live lifecycle proof.

options.title: Use a typed hook action
options.body: Replace the imperative context method with an owner-controlled after-compaction result that requests reset after hook dispatch completes.

options.title: Keep resets Gateway-owned
options.body: Decline plugin-triggered reset capability and close the PR while retaining `/new`, `/reset`, and Gateway-owned lifecycle paths.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow API
recommendation.body: Approve the current-session deferred method for successful, unlocked after-compaction hooks, then require documentation, SDK contract coverage, and complete live lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is recent work on the typed plugin hook runner and its lifecycle contracts.
